skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the concept of spatial development planning
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basic concepts, principles, and theories of spatial development planning.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Mastering the process of spatial development planning
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to follow and apply the steps involved in the process of spatial development planning.
Students will be able to analyze and apply regional economic theories to spatial development planning.
Students will be able to develop comprehensive spatial development plans for various sectors including urban and rural areas.
Students will be able to critically think about and solve problems related to spatial development planning.
Students will be able to effectively communicate and present their ideas and solutions related to spatial development planning.
Students will be able to engage in self-directed learning to enhance their understanding of spatial development planning.
